name: dsh-auto-update
description: Silent, startup-time updates for installed DSH plugins: uses the host's official plugin manager, handles exact-pinned registry dependencies, and skips the market, itself, local link installs and GitHub installs. 启动后在后台静默更新已装插件。
author: dsh-auto-update contributors
